source: Canara Engineering College – Boys and Girls Hostels: Roles and Responsibilities of Hosteller
note: These rules are transcribed from the hostel rule book supplied by the user. The document is dated 12.08.2016; confirm with the college/warden whether any rules have since changed.

sections.title: Attendance and Outpass
rules: Be within the college premises by 7:30 PM.
Be within the hostel premises before 9:30 PM for attendance, unless you are on an outpass.
Obtain an outpass from the Hostel Warden before going on holidays or vacations, well in advance.
Sign the movement register near the hostel entrance gate before leaving on an outpass or with permission.
Show the outpass or permission pass to security at the main gate while leaving the campus, and submit it to the Warden or Security on return.
While leaving on vacation, submit the outpass to Security at the main gate.
Wear the college ID while going out.
For a day's visit or outing, obtain the Warden's permission by applying in writing at least 2 days in advance.

sections.title: Hostel Cleanliness and Hygiene
rules: Room occupants are liable for damage to hostel property in their respective rooms.
Do not move furniture from its original position.
Do not scribble, draw, or paste stickers on hostel walls, furniture, wardrobes, or other hostel premises.
Keep rooms and common areas clean and available for inspection when required.
Residents of a floor are liable for damage to hostel property in that floor's common areas.
Charges for clearing bathroom blockages may be assigned to the concerned occupants.
Deposit dust and trash in the provided dustbins; do not litter inside or outside the hostel.

sections.title: Etiquette, Discipline and Safety
rules: Maintain discipline and obey hostel and college rules and regulations.
Behave politely with room-mates and other hostel residents.
Ragging is prohibited. Students found guilty may face suspension and legal penalties under college and government norms.
Keep valuables locked in the cupboards provided and take responsibility for personal belongings.
Outsiders and day scholars are not permitted to be entertained in the hostel premises.
Parents may visit the hostel with permission from the Warden.
If a room key is lost, submit a written request to the Hostel Warden to arrange opening the lock.
Do not try to break open a lock without the Warden's permission; damage caused may be charged to the concerned occupant.
The document states that the college management may refuse or withdraw hostel facilities, shift residents to alternate accommodation, or take disciplinary action for valid reasons.

sections.title: Other Guidelines
rules: Use electricity and water carefully; switch off lights and close water taps when not in use.
Damaged bulbs or tube lights caused by hostellers may be replaced at the occupants' cost.
Use the Pay & Eat facility at either of the messes available on the college campus.
Manage time well and avoid activities that interfere with classes or study time.
Inform the Warden about medical emergencies for timely action.
Hostellers may use the medical insurance facility provided by the college, as stated in the document.
Students may enrol for hostel facilities between semesters or during exams with a written request from parents submitted to the Warden.
Hostel grievances may be addressed to the Principal, Warden, or SWO through permitted channels.

warden_note: Names and hostel assignments were provided by the user. Phone numbers, email addresses, and individual roles beyond Warden have not been provided.
